Corporate Status Overview : Corporate portfolio continued to 
show positive progress in legal enforcement and portfolio 
management. 60% of the portfolio remains in the Asset seizure/ 
Auction announcement, with the Company closely monitoring the 
progress of each case. Some collateral assets are expected to 
gradually enter auction processes within 2026 , which may support 
future cash flow realization and portfolio returns. 
TDR stage declined , reflecting portfolio management progress 
through revised repayment TDR for certain debtors, as well as the 
migration of some accounts into the judgment stage in line with the 
Company’s legal strategy. While judgment stage increased , driven 
by both transfers from the TDR segment and acquisitions of new 
debt portfolios during the quarter. The increase in judgment -stage 
accounts reflects progress in legal enforcement procedures , 
enhancing visibility in portfolio management and long -term 
recovery tracking .
Overall, the majority of the Corporate portfolio is currently in legal 
proceedings. The Company continues to closely monitor and 
accelerate enforcement processes in accordance with its asset 
management timeline, supporting the gradual realization of future 
cash flows.(Unit : Million Baht)

and accelerated transaction closures. This reflects the Company ’s effective asset management capabilities and its Asset Value
